title: HubComputeAggregateView
description: Hub-level compute aggregate — sums per-device ComputeTriptych across all devices belonging to a hub. Primary UX surface for household compute capacity rendering; per-device drill-down is secondary. Hub is a *role* (dial-up-by-capability), not a notarized entity — substrate stays kind-agnostic; kind classification (dwelling/collective/computed) happens at the projection layer. Source of truth: hub-membership graph (notarized humans.household_id or collective_participations) + per-device ComputeTriptych aggregation (A2 inputs, summed). Operational Category C — reconstructed per request; not persisted.

hubId.description: Stable identifier for this hub. When hub-membership facts are not yet notarized, hubId is the peer_id of the single-device participant (Computed kind). Future: dwelling_id or collective_id when binding tables distinguish.

hubKind.description: Hub kind. dwelling = single household; collective = qahal-scoped hub; computed = ad-hoc or single-device participation. New kinds slot in here without changing API shape. Mirrors HubKind enum.

displayLabel.description: Optional human-readable label for UI display. Absent or null when no label is known.

compute.description: Aggregated compute triptych across all member devices. Null when no devices have a current sample, or when no REA commitments exist for any member.

memberDeviceCount.description: Number of member devices contributing to this aggregate. Zero is valid for a freshly-created hub with no devices yet joined.
